label: X90 Pro smartphone
description: vivo X90 Pro — 6.78-inch Dimensity 9200 flagship, Wi-Fi 6 (2.4/5 GHz, 2x2) and 5G sub-6 GHz; USB-C with Ethernet over adapter.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2 MIMO, MU-MIMO, 2.4/5 GHz) — vivo's spec sheet lists Wi-Fi 6/Wi-Fi 5, so no 6 GHz even though the SoC can do more. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz only, no mmWave. USB-C with Ethernet adapter support (usb0). Funtouch OS; good example of a flagship that is deliberately a generation behind on Wi-Fi.
